ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1.2 ratio of white-to-black pixels; high-intensity pixels dominate the left lobe while low-intensity pixels dominate the right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large contiguous white region (approx. 60% of lobe area) with distinct dark circular mottling. Right lobe contains a predominantly dark region with a localized high-contrast white patch near the median notch and smaller white spots along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 145 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 10-15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged serrations present across the entire span; average peak amplitude of 4-8 pixels; higher density of peaks observed on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge, tapering to sharp, irregular points at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of dark circular spots (diameters 4-7 pixels) on the white background of the left lobe; similar lighter circular ring structures visible on the dark background of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel dark linear disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the inner half of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged profile on the extreme right tip, indicating potential minor tissue loss or heavy barnacle colonization; small protrusion on the leading edge of the left lobe visible near the water line.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical pigmentation pattern between the left and right lobes; unique high-intensity 'teardrop' shape adjacent to the central notch on the right side.
